## Problem and visible result

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior.

## Evidence

Record the commit, commands, environment, results, and limits.
Use synthetic fixtures and redacted output only.
Separate code, local tests, real runtime, and user acceptance.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No private names, local user paths, credentials, messages, sensitive records, or image metadata.
- [ ] Root tests, demo tests, and `scripts/check_repo.py` pass locally.
- [ ] Required release validators pass, or the missing validator is explicit.
- [ ] Changed Mermaid diagrams have source checks and renderer evidence when available.
- [ ] Product-visible changes appear in `HOW_IT_WORKS.md` and relevant diagrams.
- [ ] English and Chinese public claims agree.
- [ ] Distribution claims match public evidence. Unverified channels remain `planned`.
